text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Good morning! It's time for some water—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No way... It's withered...! Why only this 
flower...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see, the tree is blocking the 
sunlight...! We have to replant it right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, little flower. It's all 
because I didn't notice you..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please hang in there just a little longer, 
okay?
